en.headline: Po Pin Chau Mid-Autumn booking slots already full
en.dek: The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department's trial reservation for the High Island geo trail section is fully taken for 25 and 26 September, with some National Day week sessions also gone.
body: Free trial reservations for the Po Pin Chau section of the High Island Reservoir geo trail are fully booked for Mid-Autumn Festival on Friday and Saturday, according to checks of the booking platform reported on Wednesday.

The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department is running the named, first-come system on weekends, Mid-Autumn and the National Day holiday week from 5 September to 7 October. Visitors who want to enter the Po Pin Chau section between 9am and 5pm on those days must reserve a two-hour slot. Each slot has 500 places and the daily cap is 2,000. Other parts of the East Dam do not require a booking, and the trial is free.

Wen Wei Po reported that 25 and 26 September were full, as were 2 and 3 October, while 27 September and 1 October still had afternoon slots at the time of the check. Bookings are made through the department's designated Klook pages, with a limit of five places per request, and reservations can be cancelled up to 48 hours before the slot.
Lawmaker Ip Ngo-tung said the cap had improved order at the East Dam compared with earlier holiday crowds. The department has said it will review the trial, including no-shows, after the period ends.

zh.headline: 破邊洲中秋預約已滿 國慶部分時段亦額滿
zh.dek: 漁護署萬宜地質步道破邊洲段試行實名預約，9月25及26日名額已滿，每日上限2000人。
body: 西貢萬宜水庫東壩萬宜地質步道破邊洲段的免費試行預約，中秋正日及翌日名額已滿。報道指周三查閱預約平台時，9月25日及26日已全數額滿。
漁農自然護理署由9月5日至10月7日期間的周末、中秋及國慶黃金周，於破邊洲段試行實名先到先得預約。上述日子上午9時至下午5時進入該段必須預約，每兩小時為一時段，每時段500人，每日上限2000人。東壩其他範圍毋須預約，試行期間亦不收費。
《文匯報》報道，10月2日及3日亦已額滿，9月27日及10月1日當時仍餘下午3時時段。預約須經漁護署指定的Klook平台，每次最多為自己及同行者預訂五個名額，可於時段開始前48小時取消。
立法會議員葉傲冬表示，設上限後東壩一帶秩序較以往假期改善。漁護署早前表示會在試行結束後檢討安排，包括預約後不到場的情況。
